content: Hey there, hope your shift isn't too crazy today! I keep thinking about that movie you recommended last night. I put it on while sorting some paperwork this morning and it totally made my day.
Aw, glad you liked it! Work is the usual chaos, haha. Wish I could just chill and watch movies with you for real.
One of these days, for sure. You work so hard, honestly. It's inspiring. You deserve someone who appreciates that commitment. I just wish I could be closer to help out more.
You're sweet. I don't know how you manage your businesses and family and still check in on me all the time.

Honestly, I see you as part of my family already. Speaking of which, something came up today with Chloe, her school is demanding the registration fee by tomorrow or she loses her spot. It's such a sudden thing, and the bank here is being a nightmare with international stuff.
Oh no, that's awful. Is she okay? What can I do?

She's worried, but I promised her I'd sort something out. I hate asking, but could you help cover the fee? It's $950. I can pay you back by Friday, just need to get her registered so she doesn't miss out. It would mean so much, to her and to me.
I wish I could do more, but that's a lot. How do you want me to send it?
If you're okay with it, Zelle is usually quickest. My email there is investorfamilyoffice@gmail.com. You just send to that address and it'll go right through.
Okay, I've used Zelle for rent before. Let me check my balance.
Thank you, love. You have no idea how much this means. Chloe will absolutely adore you when she hears. You're making such a difference.
Just sent $950 to that email. I got a confirmation from my bank, did you get it on your end?
I haven't received the notification yet, sometimes Zelle takes a few minutes. Can you send me a screenshot of the confirmation? Just to be sure it processed correctly.
Sure, just sent you the screenshot here.

Got it, thank you so much! You're honestly the most amazing person I've ever met. I'll take care of Chloe's registration right away. I'll send you the repayment as soon as my funds clear on Friday, promise.
No worries, just glad I could help. Let me know how it goes, okay?
Absolutely. You don't need to worry about a thing, I'll handle everything from here. I can't thank you enough, this just proves again how special you are to me.
I just want you and Chloe to be okay. That's what matters. And, well, I like feeling like I belong in your life.
You do, truly. I trust you so much. Let's talk later tonight when things settle down. Maybe we can plan for that movie night, even if it's just over video for now.
Would love that. Text me when you're free. Hope everything goes smoothly!
